item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 07/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect Guangdong today and tomorrow. The weather will be cold over the region. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will bring a few rain patches to the coastal areas. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream and the band of clouds covering Guangdong gradually thinning out early next week, temperatures will rise progressively and it will be brighter over the region. A warm maritime airstream is expected to bring humid and foggy weather to the coastal areas midweek next week. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of next week. Temperatures will fall over the region.
